title: frameledger import --json
description: The result of `frameledger import presentmon CAPTURE -o RUN --json`: a run file was written from another tool's capture. A later release may add keys, and values to the open sets; a script ignores what it does not know. Print this file from the same frameledger that printed the result.

frameledger.description: The version of the frameledger that printed this.

summary.description: The opening sentences of the text output, in order. Wording may change in any release.

overrides.description: The --override flags given; empty for a command that takes none.

warnings.description: The warnings, each also a sentence in summary.

process.description: The Application whose rows were kept.

not_displayed.description: The frames that were not displayed; null when the capture cannot say.

generated.description: Each FrameType other than Application with its frame count; empty when there is none, and null without a FrameType column.

unknown.description: The header fields left unknown, to give with a flag.

import_verdict.description: The verdict of import: always none, since an import judges nothing. A closed set.

import_exit_code.description: The exit codes the result of import can carry. A closed set.

code.description: What kind of warning it is. An open set: a later release may add a code, and a script ignores one it does not know. file_error says a file could not be read.

warning.description: One warning. Its sentence is also in summary.

field.description: The header field that may differ.

override.description: One blocking field a --override flag let differ.
